title: Add clearly-tagged lossy pronunciation romanization schemes (never mislabeled as reversible)
context: Pronunciation-oriented romanizations (e.g., BGN/PCGN popular schemes, Revised Romanization of Korean) are widely used but lossy: you cannot recover the original script from the romanized form. These schemes are useful for practical purposes (search normalization, input methods, display) but must be labeled honestly. A lossy scheme tagged as reversible corrupts data downstream. This task adds at least one clearly-tagged lossy scheme with an accurate loss report and a harness that does NOT assert round-trip equality.
objective: Author at least one pronunciation-oriented romanization scheme with reversibility: lossy, a comprehensive loss report, and integration into the harness that explicitly skips round-trip equality assertions for it. The scheme must never be mislabeled as strict or normalized. Per-scheme docs must make the non-reversibility unmistakable to users.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one scheme added with reversibility: lossy and a non-null, comprehensive lossReport enumerating every category of information that is dropped
Scheme validates against mappingSchemeSchema with reversibility: lossy; conformsTo cites the source scheme without copying copyrighted tables; provenanceRefs resolve to open/PD allow-listed sources
Test harness does NOT assert reverse(forward(s)) == NFC(s) for this scheme; instead performs a loss-report smoke check confirming lossReport is non-null and non-empty

Per-scheme docs make the non-reversibility unmistakable: the word 'lossy' appears in the title and the first paragraph; the not-certified disclaimer is present; the loss report is summarized prominently
Collision/bijection checker explicitly not run as a pass/fail gate for lossy schemes (or runs with a warning-only mode); documented in CI comments
Qualified per-script reviewer confirms loss report accuracy and that the scheme is correctly labeled
resources: PLAN.md — Scope (lossy class definition; non-goals: no mislabeling); M4 lossy-001 criteria
BGN/PCGN romanization systems (US-gov / Crown; verify per document)
Unicode CLDR / ICU popular romanization transforms
output: data/schemes/<lossy-scheme-id>.yaml (+ compiled JSON); data/loss-reports/<lossy-scheme-id>.md; data/schemes/docs/<lossy-scheme-id>.md; updated harness configuration
